title: Active and Passive Voice: Introduction — Quiz 101
content:
## Active and Passive Voice: Introduction

Learn how active and passive voice change the focus of a sentence.

### Lesson focus

1. Active voice: People speak English all over the world.
2. Passive voice: English is spoken all over the world.

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
